acceptance.given: A public entry with legitimate child dependencies is present in the package under validation.

oracle.expected: The package declaration and validation evidence explicitly identify every legitimate child dependency of the public entry.
forbidden: A legitimate child dependency is omitted from the public entry declaration.
The entry presents dependency requirements as absent when legitimate child dependencies exist.
oracle.observable: The validated public-entry declaration contains an explicit complete child-dependency list.

acceptance.then: The declaration explicitly identifies every legitimate child dependency.
acceptance.when: Run the repository Skill package validation and inspect the public-entry declaration during the validation phase.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the public-entry package-validation case with an omitted legitimate child dependency or an absent dependency requirement and assert that validation fails.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Package validation enforces explicit declaration of every legitimate child dependency for each public entry.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema migration is required; rollback restores prior package-validation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: A public entry moves from potentially implicit child dependencies to an explicit complete dependency declaration verified by package validation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted package-validation test suite passes for a complete declaration and rejects a declaration omitting any legitimate child dependency.
